EXACTVIEW 9 is a ship-monitoring satellite built by the University of Toronto Institute for Aerospace Studies Space Flight Laboratory. About the size of a small briefcase, exactView 9 is owned by exactEarth Ltd. of Canada, which specializes in vessel tracking services.
